map.string: 6|7 World Studio accessibility profile (interface palette preset, text scale, keyboard focus, reduce motion, custom colours, scene colour filter), as sw67::a11y::serialize writes it. Edited in the Accessibility floater; every 6|7 module reads it through SW67Accessibility.
When off (the default), the scene colour filter (RenderCVDMode) is left out of snapshots, so exported images keep their true colours. Set from the 6|7 Accessibility floater.
